title: Greets with the business name
steps: Open the chat and choose Visitor.
expected: The agent greets you with your business's name.
notes: Journey 3, step 1 (Call in). On web, Chat → Visitor stands in for the call.

title: Answers questions about the menu and prices
steps: As a visitor, ask "What do you sell?" and "How much is <product>?"
expected: Products and prices match the catalog. Nothing is made up and retired products aren't offered.

title: Answers questions about the business
steps: Ask "What time do you close?" and "What services do you offer?"
expected: Answers match the business profile from onboarding.

title: Build an order
steps: Order a few items with quantities and a note, e.g. "2 jasmine milk teas, less sugar, and 1 matcha mochi."
expected: It captures every item, quantity and note as an order list.

title: Change the order before confirming
steps: Before confirming, add one item and remove another, e.g. "Add a chocolate mochi and drop the matcha mochi."
expected: The order list updates correctly and the total reflects the change.

title: Order an unavailable item
steps: Try to order a retired product (e.g. strawberry mochi) and something that was never on the menu.
expected: It says the item isn't available, doesn't add it to the order, and suggests what's on the menu instead.

title: Customer name is captured
steps: Place an order without giving your name.
expected: The agent asks for your name and attaches it to the order.

title: Read back and confirm
steps: When the order is complete, say "That's all."
expected: It repeats the full order with each item, quantity, note and the correct total, and places the order only after you confirm.

title: Order shows correctly in memory
steps: As the owner, check the order in memory (or ask "What orders came in today?").
expected: The order is saved as its own item with the customer's name, items, quantities, notes, total and status.
